$Comment: Defeating another player: the killing blow on a player the world's PvP rules credit (never an idle player, a party member, one who just came back, or the same player again too soon; the PvP Rules screen on /zigadmin). A fall, lava or drowning death soon after your hit counts as yours. Target is always Player; the Qualifier is the item you held. The amount a step counts is 1 a kill; a track source's PerAmount reads what the kill is worth instead, the fallen player's whole health, less when the repeat guard counts it for less. A step reads {"Kind": "PLAYER_KILL", "Amount": 10}.
